profile.summary: The Berkeley Language Center is a unit in the Division of Arts & Humanities at the University of California, Berkeley. It supports teaching, learning and research on world languages and cultures on campus and beyond. It also hosts the Berkeley World Language Project, which provides professional learning for K-12 language teachers in Alameda, Contra Costa, Napa and Solano counties.
